title: A guest signs up from the signup page and lands on the welcome page signed in
state: fresh browser context, no cookies; the email below has never been used
steps: Type the email and a password from the test data
Tick the terms box and press Create account
expect: The page moves to /welcome and shows the email you used
The header shows Sign out, so the guest is signed in
No console errors and no failed requests during signup
data: email qa.s1.<current unix time>@example.test; password: any 14-character test value you make up

title: POST /api/guests creates a guest and refuses the same email twice
state: local server running; the email below has never been used
expect: The first call returns 201 and a JSON body with a non-empty id
The second call returns 409 and the body names the email as already registered
data: email qa.s2.<current unix time>@example.test; password: any 14-character test value you make up

title: An existing member still signs in from /login as before
state: the seeded member from db/seed.example.sql exists; fresh browser context
steps: Sign in with the seeded member's email and its test password from db/seed.example.sql
expect: The page moves to /dashboard and shows the member's name
The member's existing orders list still loads
data: the seeded member qa.member@example.test; its test-only password is in db/seed.example.sql

title: Invalid signup bodies are refused and create nothing
expect: Each POST returns 400 with a message that names the bad field
No response is a 500 and no response body contains a stack trace
The GET finds no guest for qa.s4@example.test
data: password: any 14-character test value you make up

title: A pasted email with spaces and capitals signs up once, not twice
steps: Type the email exactly as given, with the leading and trailing spaces and the capitals
Type the name Zoe O'Brien-Nunez test and a password, then press Create account
Sign out, open the entry URL again and sign up with the same email in lower case and no spaces
expect: The first signup succeeds and the welcome page shows the email in lower case with no spaces
The name is shown as plain text: the <b> tags appear literally and nothing is bold
The second signup is refused with an already registered message
data: email '  QA.S5.<current unix time>@Example.TEST  ' (with the spaces); password: any 14-character test value you make up
